Meeting the standards, requirements, and training for a position.

examples.text: The classification is for graduates of a class A teleman school with no significant experience and for other personnel who are not qualified for a specialized classification.

glosses: Restricted or limited by conditions.

examples.text: Assuming that I have all the information, my qualified opinion is that your plan will work.
Gatwick has been given a qualified green light to operate a second runway after the government “set out a path to expansion” for London’s second biggest airport.

examples.text: In the Ming Dynasty, a man named Zhang Weiyan in Jiangyin, of Jiangsu Province, was a skilled writer. He was quite well-known in his region.

glosses: Requiring special abilities or training.

examples.text: The minimum hourly wage for construction workers has increased to NOK 250,30 per hour for skilled workers and NOK 226,90 for unskilled workers, with an additional rate of NOK 235,80 for unskilled workers with at least one year’s experience in the industry.
